description: This PHP class 'EmailQueueService' manages email queuing and sending functionality within the OrangeHRM system. It handles adding emails to a queue, sending individual or all pending emails, changing email status, and resetting email service states. It interacts with data access objects, entity managers, and external email services, utilizing traits for logging and date-time handling.

classes.name: EmailQueueService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing email queue operations, including adding emails to the queue, sending emails (single and batch), updating email statuses, and resetting the email service state. It utilizes traits for logging, date-time utilities, and entity management.

methods.name: getEmailQueueDao
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the EmailQueueDao instance used for database operations related to email queue entries.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the EmailService instance used to send emails.

methods.name: addToQueue
methods.description: Creates a new Mail object with specified parameters and saves it to the email queue database.

methods.name: sendSingleMail
methods.description: Sends an individual email identified by mail ID, with concurrency control using database locks, and updates email status based on send outcome.

methods.name: resetEmailService
methods.description: Resets the email message fields in the EmailService instance to default empty values.

methods.name: changeMailStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a Mail object, setting sent time if applicable, and saves the changes.

methods.name: sendAllPendingMails
methods.description: Retrieves all pending email IDs from the queue and attempts to send each one.
